claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b089] Batch-level scope decisions for this file (whole document, lines 1–164). Out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5 and therefore NOT extracted: the revision-banner and changelog dates, session numbers (Session 103), hypothesis and audit identifiers (H3, H9, E56, D17 audit U4/U5), preregistration line-number citations (`osf/preregistration.md:501`, `:519-521`), commit hashes (`db582f1d`, `fd52bb82`, `811bc9b5`), preregistration section references (§8.2, §8.9), and numbers inside artefact or condition names (`pv-diag-384`, `n1-baseline-matrix-384`, `flash-minimal-text-n30-t07`, `image-n5`, `pro-text-high-t-0-0`, `55maps`, `pv-diag-384-consensus-14buf-mcc-2026-06-05.json`). Also treated as method labels rather than claims: 'the project-canonical **N=1** leaderboard method' (line 26) and the 'Pool (T=0.7)' / 'deployable N=5' column headers at line 76, whose values are extracted from the Method section instead. Vote/pool notations that ARE extracted (`26-of-30`, `4-of-5`, `3-of-5`, `N=5`) are extracted because this document asserts them as the operating points that were run, and they resolve mechanically against planning/diversity-dividend-cells-2026-06-06.json. The 0.5 swap probability is a constant inside scripts/n1_baseline_leaderboard_tiering.py rather than a recorded output, hence anchor-unknown.
